snippet.title: the first multiplayer playtest went about as expected
snippet.description:
Rallied the troops so we could kill each other repeatedly in my insane arena shooter

Wishlist Prego Wars: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3085060/Prego_Wars/
Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/ZY7DX958pe

Everyone banded together to test the game in its really early state, and in between the game crashes and errors, I think we had a bit of fun! It's really encouraging to get feedback, and SUPER COOL to try out these mechanics against real people for the first time!

12:37 End
